title: Sign Up
description: Go to gem.gov.in → Sign Up → Seller
tips: Choose correct business type: manufacturer, trader, or service provider
Wrong choice = can't list correct products later

title: Aadhaar Verification
tips: Mobile must be linked to Aadhaar
If OTP fails, visit Aadhaar centre to update mobile

title: PAN Validation
description: Enter PAN, system validates against income tax
tips: Common rejection: 'RAMESH KUMAR' vs 'RAMESH KUMAR S'

title: Organization Details
tips: Business name must match PAN/GST exactly

title: Bank Details
description: Account number, IFSC, penny drop verification
tips: Name on bank account must match PAN holder
